messages.body: We can't really have a welcome back title for security reasons. people shouldn't be able to type in my email address and be able to see that I have an account in this platform.

Done in Hi-Fi and Lo-Fi 1.2 Returning.vue: the heading is now “Log in to Endless Access” and the lead “Enter your password to continue.”, with no name and no “welcome back”. The note for marker 3 now says why. One leak remains: after Continue, an email with an account gets the password field and one without goes to the sign-up form, so the next page still shows whether an account exists. Closing it means making that next step the same for every email, for example a sign-in code sent to the inbox, or always asking for a password. Both change the one-door flow, so I left that for you to decide.
